rationale: R037 17-series meta-harvest shows the best clues cluster around anchored liquidity/value plus delayed confirmation/retest, while raw indicators, naked breakouts, generic candlesticks and raw microstructure repeatedly fail. SVWAPR tests a previously untested volume-weighted session-value anchor with causal first-touch reclaim timing.

source_basis.use: VWAP = cumulative typical-price x tick-volume / cumulative tick-volume; session reset; volume-weighted sigma bands; tick volume is an accepted Forex proxy.
Confirmed-anchor / deviation-band implementation; first-touch retest vs breakaway framing; tick volume disclosure.
Public AVWAP definition and volume-weighted anchor semantics.
Community caution that VWAP should be context plus reaction rather than touch-only; trend-day pullback framing.
Reconstructible XAUUSD M5 rule: wick touch with open and close on same side; first valid setup.
Negative control: unconditional VWAP mean-reversion in COMEX gold is not promoted; this prereg explicitly tests trend-side reclaim instead of naked fade.

sessions.LONDON: project DST-aware London session open; January open 08:00 UTC
sessions.NEW_YORK: project DST-aware New York session open; January open 13:00 UTC

event_grammar.arm_long: completed bar closes >= VWAP + 1 sigma and VWAP slope is positive
event_grammar.arm_short: completed bar closes <= VWAP - 1 sigma and VWAP slope is negative
event_grammar.trigger_long: first subsequent completed bar whose wick touches/crosses VWAP, open and close remain above VWAP, close>open, VWAP slope remains positive
event_grammar.trigger_short: first subsequent completed bar whose wick touches/crosses VWAP, open and close remain below VWAP, close<open, VWAP slope remains negative
event_grammar.first_touch_consumption: the first VWAP interaction after arming consumes the event whether it confirms or fails
event_grammar.rearm: requires a fresh completed-bar close beyond the same 1-sigma excursion after consumption
event_grammar.session_reset: all state resets at session end
event_grammar.signal_time: first executable P75 tick at or after the confirming completed-bar end
event_grammar.per_session_limit: at most one executed signal per side per session

gates.advance_rule: Only a preregistered profile passing all activity gates and nonnegative direct net may advance to independent later-January validation.
